                _ => {}
            }
        }
        if let Some(Token::Ident(name)) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Ident(_))) {
            if self.next_is(Token::OpenParen) {
                let mut args = Vec::new();
                loop {
                    args.push(self.parse_expression()?);
                    if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
                }
                self.expect(Token::CloseParen)?;
                return Ok(ast::Expression::Function(name, args));
            }
            return Ok(ast::Expression::Column(None, name));
        }
        if let Some(Token::Number(s)) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Number(_))) {
            if let Ok(i) = s.parse::<i64>() {
                return Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::Integer(i)));
            }
            if let Ok(f) = s.parse::<f64>() {
                return Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::Float(f)));
            }
            return errinput!("invalid number {s}");
        }
        if let Some(Token::String(s)) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::String(_))) {
            return Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::String(s)));
        }
        errinput!("unexpected token {}", self.peek()?.unwrap_or(&Token::Semicolon))
    }

    fn parse_prefix_operator_at(&mut self, min_precedence: Precedence) -> Option<PrefixOperator> {
        if let Some(kw) = self.next_if_keyword() {
            match kw {
                Keyword::Not => return Some(PrefixOperator::Not),
                Keyword::Plus => return Some(PrefixOperator::Plus),
                Keyword::Minus => return Some(PrefixOperator::Minus),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        None
    }

    fn parse_infix_operator_at(&mut self, min_precedence: Precedence) -> Option<InfixOperator> {
        if let Some(op) = self.parse_postfix_operator_at(min_precedence).ok().flatten() {
            return Some(op.into_infix());
        }
        if let Some(kw) = self.next_if_keyword() {
            match kw {
                Keyword::And => return Some(InfixOperator::And),
                Keyword::Or => return Some(InfixOperator::Or),
                Keyword::Is => return Some(InfixOperator::Is),
                Keyword::Like => return Some(InfixOperator::Like),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Equal)) {
            if token == Token::Equal { return Some(InfixOperator::Equal); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::NotEqual)) {
            if token == Token::NotEqual { return Some(InfixOperator::NotEqual); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::GreaterThan)) {
            if token == Token::GreaterThan { return Some(InfixOperator::GreaterThan); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::GreaterThanOrEqual)) {
            if token == Token::GreaterThanOrEqual { return Some(InfixOperator::GreaterThanOrEqual); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::LessThan)) {
            if token == Token::LessThan { return Some(InfixOperator::LessThan); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::LessThanOrEqual)) {
            if token == Token::LessThanOrEqual { return Some(InfixOperator::LessThanOrEqual); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Plus)) {
            if token == Token::Plus { return Some(InfixOperator::Add); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Minus)) {
            if token == Token::Minus { return Some(InfixOperator::Subtract); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Asterisk)) {
            if token == Token::Asterisk { return Some(InfixOperator::Multiply); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Slash)) {
            if token == Token::Slash { return Some(InfixOperator::Divide); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Caret)) {
            if token == Token::Caret { return Some(InfixOperator::Exponentiate); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Percent)) {
            if token == Token::Percent { return Some(InfixOperator::Remainder); }
        }
        None
    }

    fn parse_postfix_operator_at(&mut self, min_precedence: Precedence) -> Result<Option<PostfixOperator>> {
        if self.next_is(Token::Exclamation) {
            return Ok(Some(PostfixOperator::Factorial));
        }
        if let Some(kw) = self.next_if_keyword() {
            if kw == Keyword::Not {
                if let Some(lit) = self.parse_is_literal()? {
                    return Ok(Some(PostfixOperator::IsNot(lit)));
                }
            } else if kw == Keyword::Is {
                if let Some(lit) = self.parse_is_literal()? {
                    return Ok(Some(PostfixOperator::Is(lit)));
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(None)
    }

    fn parse_is_literal(&mut self) -> Result<Option<ast::Literal>> {
        if self.next_is(Keyword::Null.into()) {
            return Ok(Some(ast::Literal::Null));
        }
        if self.next_is(Keyword::Nan.into()) {
            return Ok(Some(ast::Literal::Float(f64::NAN)));
        }
        Ok(None)
    }

    fn parse_column_list(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
        self.expect(Token::OpenParen)?;
        let mut cols = Vec::new();
        loop {
            cols.push(self.next_ident()?);
            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
        }
        self.expect(Token::CloseParen)?;
        Ok(cols)
    }

    fn parse_value_list(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<ast::Expression>> {
        self.expect(Token::OpenParen)?;
        let mut vals = Vec::new();
        loop {
            vals.push(self.parse_expression()?);
            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
        }
        self.expect(Token::CloseParen)?;
        Ok(vals)
    }
}

type Precedence = u8;

enum Associativity {
    Left,
    Right,
}

impl Add<Associativity> for Precedence {
    type Output = Self;

    fn add(self, rhs: Associativity) -> Self {
        match rhs {
            Associativity::Left => self,
            Associativity::Right => self + 1,
        }
    }
}

enum PrefixOperator {
    Minus,
    Not,
    Plus,
}

impl PrefixOperator {
    fn precedence(&self) -> Precedence {
        10
    }

    fn associativity(&self) -> Associativity {
        Associativity::Right
    }

    fn into_expression(self, rhs: ast::Expression) -> ast::Expression {
        match self {
            Self::Minus => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Negate(Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Not => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Not(Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Plus => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Identity(Box::new(rhs))),
        }
    }
}

enum InfixOperator {
    Add,
    And,
    Divide,
    Equal,
    Exponentiate,
    GreaterThan,
    GreaterThanOrEqual,
    Is,
    LessThan,
    LessThanOrEqual,
    Like,
    Multiply,
    NotEqual,
    Or,
    Remainder,
    Subtract,
}

impl InfixOperator {
    fn precedence(&self) -> Precedence {
        match self {
            Self::Or => 1,
            Self::And => 2,
            Self::Is | Self::Like => 4,
            Self::Equal | Self::NotEqual | Self::GreaterThan | Self::GreaterThanOrEqual | Self::LessThan | Self::LessThanOrEqual => 5,
            Self::Add | Self::Subtract => 6,
            Self::Multiply | Self::Divide | Self::Remainder => 7,
            Self::Exponentiate => 8,
        }
    }

    fn associativity(&self) -> Associativity {
        Associativity::Left
    }

    fn into_expression(self, lhs: ast::Expression, rhs: ast::Expression) -> ast::Expression {
        match self {
            Self::Add => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Add(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::And => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::And(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Divide => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Divide(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Equal => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Equal(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Exponentiate => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Exponentiate(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::GreaterThan => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::GreaterThan(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::GreaterThanOrEqual => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::GreaterThanOrEqual(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Is => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Is(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs.into()) as Box<ast::Literal>)),
            Self::LessThan => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::LessThan(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::LessThanOrEqual => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::LessThanOrEqual(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Like => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Like(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Multiply => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Multiply(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::NotEqual => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::NotEqual(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Or => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Or(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Remainder => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Remainder(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Subtract => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Subtract(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
        }
    }
}

enum PostfixOperator {
    Factorial,
    Is(ast::Literal),
    IsNot(ast::Literal),
}

impl PostfixOperator {
    fn precedence(&self) -> Precedence {
        9
    }

    fn into_expression(self, lhs: ast::Expression) -> ast::Expression {
        match self {
            Self::Factorial => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Factorial(Box::new(lhs))),
            Self::Is(lit) => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Is(Box::new(lhs), lit)),
            Self::IsNot(lit) => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Is(Box::new(lhs), ast::Literal::Null)),
        }
    }

    fn into_infix(self) -> InfixOperator {
        match self {
            Self::Is(_) => InfixOperator::Is,
            Self::IsNot(_) => InfixOperator::Is,
            Self::Factorial => InfixOperator::Equal,
        }
    }
}

                Keyword::Rollback => self.parse_rollback(),
                Keyword::Explain => self.parse_explain(),
                Keyword::Create => self.parse_create_table(),
                Keyword::Drop => self.parse_drop_table(),

                Keyword::Insert => self.parse_insert(),
                Keyword::Update => self.parse_update(),

    fn parse_rollback(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Statement> {
        Ok(ast::Statement::Rollback)
    }

    fn parse_explain(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Statement> {

        let if_exists = self.next_is(Keyword::If.into());
        if if_exists {
            self.expect(Keyword::Exists.into())?;
        }
        let name = self.next_ident()?;
        Ok(ast::Statement::DropTable { name, if_exists })
    }

    fn parse_delete(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Statement> {
        self.expect(Keyword::From.into())?;
        let table = self.next_ident()?;
        let mut r#where = None;
        if self.next_is(Keyword::Where.into()) {
            r#where = Some(self.parse_expression()?);
        }
        Ok(ast::Statement::Delete { table, r#where })
    }

    fn parse_insert(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Statement> {
        self.expect(Keyword::Into.into())?;
        let table = self.next_ident()?;
        let mut columns = None;
        if self.next_is(Token::OpenParen) {
            columns = Some(self.parse_column_list()?);
        }
        self.expect(Keyword::Values.into())?;
        let mut values = Vec::new();
        loop {
            values.push(self.parse_value_list()?);
            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
        }
        Ok(ast::Statement::Insert { table, columns, values })
    }

    fn parse_update(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Statement> {

            let col = self.next_ident()?;
            self.expect(Token::Equal)?;

            };
            set.insert(col, expr);
            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
        }

        if self.next_is(Keyword::Where.into()) {
            r#where = Some(self.parse_expression()?);
        }
        Ok(ast::Statement::Update { table, set, r#where })
    }

    fn parse_select(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Statement> {
        let select = self.parse_select_clause()?;
        let from = self.parse_from_clause()?;
        let r#where = self.parse_where_clause()?;
        let group_by = self.parse_group_by_clause()?;
        let having = self.parse_having_clause()?;
        let order_by = self.parse_order_by_clause()?;
        let offset = self.parse_offset_clause()?;
        let limit = self.parse_limit_clause()?;
        Ok(ast::Statement::Select { select, from, r#where, group_by, having, order_by, offset, limit })
    }

    fn parse_select_clause(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<(ast::Expression, Option<String>)>> {
        let mut select = Vec::new();
        loop {
            let expr = self.parse_expression()?;
            let mut alias = None;
            if self.next_is(Keyword::As.into()) {
                alias = Some(self.next_ident()?);
            } else if let ast::Expression::Column(_, name) = &expr {
                if name != "*" {
                    alias = Some(name.clone());
                }
            }
            select.push((expr, alias));
            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
        }
        Ok(select)
    }

    fn parse_from_clause(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<ast::From>> {

            return Ok(Vec::new());
        }
        let mut from = Vec::new();
        loop {

            } else {
                from.push(table);
            }
            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
        }
        Ok(from)
    }

    fn parse_from_table(&mut self) -> Result<ast::From> {
        let name = self.next_ident()?;
        let mut alias = None;
        if self.next_is(Keyword::As.into()) {
            alias = Some(self.next_ident()?);
        } else if let Some(kw) = self.next_if_keyword() {
            if !matches!(kw, Keyword::Join | Keyword::Inner | Keyword::Left | Keyword::Right | Keyword::Cross | Keyword::On | Keyword::Where | Keyword::Group | Keyword::Having | Keyword::Order | Keyword::Limit | Keyword::Offset) {
                alias = Some(kw.to_string().to_lowercase());
            } else {
                self.lexer.next();
            }
        }
        Ok(ast::From::Table { name, alias })
    }

    fn parse_from_join(&mut self) -> Result<Option<ast::JoinType>> {
        if let Some(kw) = self.next_if_keyword() {
            match kw {
                Keyword::Inner => Ok(Some(ast::JoinType::Inner)),
                Keyword::Left => Ok(Some(ast::JoinType::Left)),
                Keyword::Right => Ok(Some(ast::JoinType::Right)),
                Keyword::Cross => Ok(Some(ast::JoinType::Cross)),
                _ => { self.lexer.next(); Ok(None) },
            }
        } else {
            Ok(None)
        }
    }

    fn parse_where_clause(&mut self) -> Result<Option<ast::Expression>> {
        if !self.next_is(Keyword::Where.into()) {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        Ok(Some(self.parse_expression()?))
    }

    fn parse_group_by_clause(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<ast::Expression>> {
        if !self.next_is(Keyword::Group.into()) {
            return Ok(Vec::new());
        }
        self.expect(Keyword::By.into())?;
        let mut group_by = Vec::new();
        loop {
            group_by.push(self.parse_expression()?);
            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
        }
        Ok(group_by)
    }

    fn parse_having_clause(&mut self) -> Result<Option<ast::Expression>> {
        if !self.next_is(Keyword::Having.into()) {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        Ok(Some(self.parse_expression()?))
    }

    fn parse_order_by_clause(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<(ast::Expression, ast::Direction)>> {
        if !self.next_is(Keyword::Order.into()) {
            return Ok(Vec::new());
        }
        self.expect(Keyword::By.into())?;
        let mut order_by = Vec::new();
        loop {
            let expr = self.parse_expression()?;
            let mut dir = ast::Direction::Ascending;
            if self.next_is(Keyword::Asc.into()) {
                dir = ast::Direction::Ascending;
            } else if self.next_is(Keyword::Desc.into()) {
                dir = ast::Direction::Descending;
            }
            order_by.push((expr, dir));
            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
        }
        Ok(order_by)
    }

    fn parse_limit_clause(&mut self) -> Result<Option<ast::Expression>> {
        if !self.next_is(Keyword::Limit.into()) {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        Ok(Some(self.parse_expression()?))
    }

    fn parse_offset_clause(&mut self) -> Result<Option<ast::Expression>> {
        if !self.next_is(Keyword::Offset.into()) {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        Ok(Some(self.parse_expression()?))
    }

    fn parse_expression(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Expression> {
        self.parse_expression_at(0)

    fn parse_expression_at(&mut self, min_precedence: Precedence) -> Result<ast::Expression> {

                lhs = op.into_expression(lhs, rhs);
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        Ok(lhs)
    }

        }

    fn parse_prefix_operator_at(&mut self, min_precedence: Precedence) -> Option<PrefixOperator> {

            match kw {
                Keyword::Not => return Some(PrefixOperator::Not),
                Keyword::Plus => return Some(PrefixOperator::Plus),
                Keyword::Minus => return Some(PrefixOperator::Minus),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        None
    }

                Keyword::Or => return Some(InfixOperator::Or),

        }

            if token == Token::NotEqual { return Some(InfixOperator::NotEqual); }
        }

            if token == Token::GreaterThan { return Some(InfixOperator::GreaterThan); }
        }

            if token == Token::GreaterThanOrEqual { return Some(InfixOperator::GreaterThanOrEqual); }
        }

        }

            if token == Token::LessThanOrEqual { return Some(InfixOperator::LessThanOrEqual); }
        }

            if token == Token::Plus { return Some(InfixOperator::Add); }
        }

            if token == Token::Minus { return Some(InfixOperator::Subtract); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Asterisk)) {
            if token == Token::Asterisk { return Some(InfixOperator::Multiply); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Slash)) {
            if token == Token::Slash { return Some(InfixOperator::Divide); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Caret)) {
            if token == Token::Caret { return Some(InfixOperator::Exponentiate); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Percent)) {
            if token == Token::Percent { return Some(InfixOperator::Remainder); }
        }
        None
    }

    fn parse_postfix_operator_at(&mut self, min_precedence: Precedence) -> Result<Option<PostfixOperator>> {
        if self.next_is(Token::Exclamation) {
            return Ok(Some(PostfixOperator::Factorial));
        }

                }

                if let Some(lit) = self.parse_is_literal()? {
                    return Ok(Some(PostfixOperator::Is(lit)));
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(None)
    }

    fn parse_is_literal(&mut self) -> Result<Option<ast::Literal>> {
        if self.next_is(Keyword::Null.into()) {
            return Ok(Some(ast::Literal::Null));
        }
        if self.next_is(Keyword::Nan.into()) {
            return Ok(Some(ast::Literal::Float(f64::NAN)));
        }
        Ok(None)
    }

    fn parse_column_list(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
        self.expect(Token::OpenParen)?;
        let mut cols = Vec::new();
        loop {
            cols.push(self.next_ident()?);
            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
        }
        self.expect(Token::CloseParen)?;
        Ok(cols)
    }

    fn parse_value_list(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<ast::Expression>> {
        self.expect(Token::OpenParen)?;
        let mut vals = Vec::new();
        loop {
            vals.push(self.parse_expression()?);
            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
        }
        self.expect(Token::CloseParen)?;
        Ok(vals)
    }

enum Associativity {

    Right,

                    if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
                }
                self.expect(Token::CloseParen)?;
                return Ok(ast::Expression::Function(name, args));
            }
            return Ok(ast::Expression::Column(None, name));
        }
        if let Some(Token::Number(s)) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Number(_))) {
            if let Ok(i) = s.parse::<i64>() {
                return Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::Integer(i)));
            }
            if let Ok(f) = s.parse::<f64>() {
                return Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::Float(f)));
            }
            return errinput!("invalid number {s}");
        }
        if let Some(Token::String(s)) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::String(_))) {
            return Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::String(s)));
        }
        errinput!("unexpected token {}", self.peek()?.unwrap_or(&Token::Semicolon))
    }

    fn parse_prefix_operator_at(&mut self, min_precedence: Precedence) -> Option<PrefixOperator> {
        if let Some(kw) = self.next_if_keyword() {
            match kw {
                Keyword::Not => return Some(PrefixOperator::Not),
                Keyword::Plus => return Some(PrefixOperator::Plus),
                Keyword::Minus => return Some(PrefixOperator::Minus),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        None
    }

    fn parse_infix_operator_at(&mut self, min_precedence: Precedence) -> Option<InfixOperator> {
        if let Some(op) = self.parse_postfix_operator_at(min_precedence).ok().flatten() {
            return Some(op.into_infix());
        }
        if let Some(kw) = self.next_if_keyword() {
            match kw {
                Keyword::And => return Some(InfixOperator::And),
                Keyword::Or => return Some(InfixOperator::Or),
                Keyword::Is => return Some(InfixOperator::Is),
                Keyword::Like => return Some(InfixOperator::Like),
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Equal)) {
            if token == Token::Equal { return Some(InfixOperator::Equal); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::NotEqual)) {
            if token == Token::NotEqual { return Some(InfixOperator::NotEqual); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::GreaterThan)) {
            if token == Token::GreaterThan { return Some(InfixOperator::GreaterThan); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::GreaterThanOrEqual)) {
            if token == Token::GreaterThanOrEqual { return Some(InfixOperator::GreaterThanOrEqual); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::LessThan)) {
            if token == Token::LessThan { return Some(InfixOperator::LessThan); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::LessThanOrEqual)) {
            if token == Token::LessThanOrEqual { return Some(InfixOperator::LessThanOrEqual); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Plus)) {
            if token == Token::Plus { return Some(InfixOperator::Add); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Minus)) {
            if token == Token::Minus { return Some(InfixOperator::Subtract); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Asterisk)) {
            if token == Token::Asterisk { return Some(InfixOperator::Multiply); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Slash)) {
            if token == Token::Slash { return Some(InfixOperator::Divide); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Caret)) {
            if token == Token::Caret { return Some(InfixOperator::Exponentiate); }
        }
        if let Some(token) = self.next_if(|t| matches!(t, Token::Percent)) {
            if token == Token::Percent { return Some(InfixOperator::Remainder); }
        }
        None
    }

    fn parse_postfix_operator_at(&mut self, min_precedence: Precedence) -> Result<Option<PostfixOperator>> {
        if self.next_is(Token::Exclamation) {
            return Ok(Some(PostfixOperator::Factorial));
        }
        if let Some(kw) = self.next_if_keyword() {
            if kw == Keyword::Not {
                if let Some(lit) = self.parse_is_literal()? {
                    return Ok(Some(PostfixOperator::IsNot(lit)));
                }
            } else if kw == Keyword::Is {
                if let Some(lit) = self.parse_is_literal()? {
                    return Ok(Some(PostfixOperator::Is(lit)));
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(None)
    }

    fn parse_is_literal(&mut self) -> Result<Option<ast::Literal>> {
        if self.next_is(Keyword::Null.into()) {
            return Ok(Some(ast::Literal::Null));
        }
        if self.next_is(Keyword::Nan.into()) {
            return Ok(Some(ast::Literal::Float(f64::NAN)));
        }
        Ok(None)
    }

    fn parse_column_list(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
        self.expect(Token::OpenParen)?;
        let mut cols = Vec::new();
        loop {
            cols.push(self.next_ident()?);
            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
        }
        self.expect(Token::CloseParen)?;
        Ok(cols)
    }

    fn parse_value_list(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<ast::Expression>> {
        self.expect(Token::OpenParen)?;
        let mut vals = Vec::new();
        loop {
            vals.push(self.parse_expression()?);
            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) { break; }
        }
        self.expect(Token::CloseParen)?;
        Ok(vals)
    }

type Precedence = u8;

enum Associativity {
    Left,
    Right,
}

impl Add<Associativity> for Precedence {
    type Output = Self;

    fn add(self, rhs: Associativity) -> Self {
        match rhs {
            Associativity::Left => self,
            Associativity::Right => self + 1,
        }
    }
}

    Minus,
    Not,
    Plus,
}

    fn associativity(&self) -> Associativity {

    fn into_expression(self, rhs: ast::Expression) -> ast::Expression {
        match self {
            Self::Minus => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Negate(Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Not => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Not(Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Plus => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Identity(Box::new(rhs))),

    }
}

enum InfixOperator {
    Add,
    And,
    Divide,
    Equal,
    Exponentiate,
    GreaterThan,
    GreaterThanOrEqual,
    Is,
    LessThan,
    LessThanOrEqual,
    Like,
    Multiply,
    NotEqual,
    Or,
    Remainder,
    Subtract,
}

impl InfixOperator {
    fn precedence(&self) -> Precedence {
        match self {
            Self::Or => 1,
            Self::And => 2,
            Self::Is | Self::Like => 4,
            Self::Equal | Self::NotEqual | Self::GreaterThan | Self::GreaterThanOrEqual | Self::LessThan | Self::LessThanOrEqual => 5,
            Self::Add | Self::Subtract => 6,
            Self::Multiply | Self::Divide | Self::Remainder => 7,

    fn associativity(&self) -> Associativity {
        Associativity::Left
    }

    fn into_expression(self, lhs: ast::Expression, rhs: ast::Expression) -> ast::Expression {
        match self {
            Self::Add => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Add(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::And => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::And(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),

            Self::LessThanOrEqual => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::LessThanOrEqual(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Like => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Like(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
            Self::Multiply => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Multiply(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),

            Self::Subtract => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Subtract(Box::new(lhs), Box::new(rhs))),
        }
    }
}

enum PostfixOperator {
    Factorial,
    Is(ast::Literal),
    IsNot(ast::Literal),
}

impl PostfixOperator {
    fn precedence(&self) -> Precedence {
        9
    }

    fn into_expression(self, lhs: ast::Expression) -> ast::Expression {
        match self {
            Self::Factorial => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Factorial(Box::new(lhs))),
            Self::Is(lit) => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Is(Box::new(lhs), lit)),
            Self::IsNot(lit) => ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Is(Box::new(lhs), ast::Literal::Null)),
        }
    }

    fn into_infix(self) -> InfixOperator {
        match self {
            Self::Is(_) => InfixOperator::Is,
            Self::IsNot(_) => InfixOperator::Is,
            Self::Factorial => InfixOperator::Equal,
        }
    }
}

## Background

toydb is a distributed SQL database with a layered architecture. The storage engine, MVCC transaction layer, and Raft consensus layer are fully implemented and working. The SQL engine sits on top of these layers — its method bodies have been replaced with `todo!()` stubs.

The skeleton compiles (`cargo check` passes) but all tests fail at runtime because every function hits `todo!()`.

## Instructions

You must implement all method bodies in these 10 files:

- `src/sql/parser/lexer.rs` — SQL tokenizer
- `src/sql/parser/parser.rs` — SQL parser
- `src/sql/planner/planner.rs` — query planner
- `src/sql/planner/plan.rs` — plan nodes and execution dispatch
- `src/sql/planner/optimizer.rs` — query optimizations
- `src/sql/execution/executor.rs` — query executor
- `src/sql/execution/session.rs` — session management
- `src/sql/execution/aggregator.rs` — aggregate functions
- `src/sql/execution/join.rs` — join implementations

**Do not modify** any other source files or test files. Type names, trait definitions, and function signatures are fixed. You may add private helpers, but existing public signatures must remain as defined.

## Reference

Study the existing codebase to understand the interfaces your code must satisfy:

- `src/sql/types/` — data types, expressions, schema definitions
- `src/sql/parser/ast.rs` — AST node definitions
- `src/sql/engine/engine.rs` — `Engine`, `Transaction`, `Catalog` traits
- `src/storage/` and `src/encoding/` — underlying storage and serialization
- `docs/architecture/` — detailed architecture documentation

## Testing

```bash
cargo test               # Run all tests
cargo test --lib sql     # Run SQL tests only
```

Test scripts are in `src/sql/testscripts/` organized by category (expressions, queries, schema, transactions, writes, optimizers).

## Feature Implementation Roadmap

This section outlines the phased approach to increasing SQL engine complexity, with feature descriptions for each mechanism.

### 1. Scalar Function Registry + Core Built-ins

- **Description:** Registry for scalar functions (length, lower, upper, trim, abs, round, ceil, floor, coalesce, nullif, now). Enables extensible function lookup and evaluation.

### 2. CASE Expressions

- **Description:** Support for simple/searched CASE ... WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END expressions in queries.

### 3. IN / BETWEEN Predicates

- **Description:** Implement IN, NOT IN, and BETWEEN predicates for filtering in WHERE/HAVING.

### 4. EXISTS and Scalar Subqueries

- **Description:** Support EXISTS, NOT EXISTS, and scalar subqueries in WHERE and SELECT.

### 5. Non-recursive CTEs (WITH)

- **Description:** Implement WITH clause for non-recursive common table expressions.

### 6. UNION ALL / UNION

- **Description:** Support UNION ALL and UNION for combining result sets.

### 7. Upsert (ON CONFLICT)

- **Description:** Implement INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE/NOTHING for upsert semantics.

### 8. CHECK Constraints

- **Description:** Support CHECK constraints for row-level predicate enforcement.

### 9. ALTER TABLE Basics

- **Description:** Implement ALTER TABLE for add/drop column, defaults, nullable changes, index add/drop.

### 10. Window Functions

- **Description:** Support window functions (row_number, rank, dense_rank, lag, lead, running aggregates).
